impact.text: This forces the protocol to carry a toxic, insolvent position for longer than it should, increasing the risk of massive bad debt when the position is eventually closed at a much worse price.

precondition_sources.text: An attacker holds a large long position.
The attacker places a wall of large BUY orders with a short expiry time (e.g., 60 seconds) at prices far below the current market.
After the short expiry elapses, the placed BUY orders are expired and would be ignored by the real matching engine.
The real market price (indexPrice) falls sharply, putting the attacker's long position at risk of liquidation.

intent_sources.text: The impact price simulation must not count expired resting orders as available liquidity when computing order book depth.
The markPrice derived from the impact price must reflect the real market price rather than liquidity that no longer exists.
